An interactive simulation of discrete charges in conductors and insulators. Place fixed and free charges, draw conducting or insulating regions, and watch electrons rearrange: free charge in a conductor moves to its surfaces until the field inside vanishes, while bound charge in an insulator only shifts slightly, polarizing it and partly reducing the field.
